jsonObject.summary: Creates the JSON text for an empty object, ready for named fields.
prerequisites: Import JSON and its declared dependencies.

examples.title: Use empty JSON object
examples.explanation: Block notation: Creates the JSON text for an empty object, ready for named fields. The text {}.

notes: Build and edit JSON text. Start with empty object or array. Paths use /field and /items/0 (arrays start at zero); an empty path selects the whole value. Escape / as ~1 and ~ as ~0 in field names. Set returns a new document, so assign it back to your variable. Missing parents are errors. Values supplied to set/append are JSON: 42, true, null, an object or array. Use text as JSON to quote ordinary text. Read value returns JSON text; read text decodes a string. Numbers retain their exact JSON spelling. Limits: 4096 bytes, depth 16, 128 values including keys; no duplicate fields. Errors return false in raw calls or a readable error in convenience blocks. JSONata is not included. Requires a firmware with the separate json primitive set; older P4 firmware needs a later update.
Source: integration\JSON.ubl. Examples are illustrative block notation, not hardware acceptance tests.
